tools.description: The weekly Builders Fintech Funding Index of approved equity rounds (ISO weeks). Arguments: week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W39') returns that week; otherwise the latest weeks, newest first. weeks (optional, 1–104, default 1) sets how many. Count Index = rounds this week / average of the prior 12 weeks × 100. USD median index uses disclosed USD rounds only (needs 5). Amounts are never converted. Published values are frozen; revised_* shows later corrections. coverage_affected is true when a coverage change falls in the week or its 12-week baseline; coverage_note then explains how the index overstates activity. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week, 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W39'). Omit for the latest.

tools.description: Search fintech products by text, category, market, API availability, agent access (has_mcp, has_sandbox, has_api) or customer type. Each product carries an agent_access object (api_available, docs_url, openapi_url, sandbox_url, llms_txt_url, auth_method, mcp_url) when any of these is set. Company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset. Each result carries provided_by, last_confirmed_at and sponsored; sponsorship never changes ordering. Arguments: q (or query) matched against name and short description; with no q the tool lists products alphabetically. cursor is the opaque next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.description: Find companies by product category, licence (licensed_in matches the home country or any passported country), licence type, authority, and agent access (has_sandbox, has_mcp, has_api), optionally min_agent_ready (1–5, the product's Agent-Ready score; available once those results are published). Returns each company with its approved products (with agent_access), LEI, licence summaries and self-reported certifications. Every licence carries source_url and last_checked_at so you can verify it on the regulator's register. From public registers as of the last-checked date. Always confirm on the regulator's register before relying on it. Use list_provider_filters for valid slugs. Ordered by company name, then slug. cursor is the next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

has_api.description: Only companies with a product that has an API (flag, docs or OpenAPI).

has_mcp.description: Only companies with a product that has a public MCP server.

has_sandbox.description: Only companies with a product that has a sandbox.

licensed_in.description: Two-letter ISO country code; matches home or passported licences.

min_agent_ready.description: Only companies with a product whose Agent-Ready score is at least this (1–5). Available once Agent-Ready results are published.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.
